outdoor.note: 雪亭镇 from outside: the paved square with its old wooden frame, 饮风客栈 west of it with its door on the square and its south wall on the street to the highway; 雪亭镇大街 north past the shops (钱庄, 打铁铺, 药铺, 雪亭驿 west; 加工厂 and the 当铺 east) to the memorial arch and the col; east of the street's south end the 武馆 gate court, its stone lions and flagpole before the red gate in the compound's wall; the 城隍庙 at the square's east side with its back door on the yellow-earth path that winds east up to the mountain road; the street south to the woods, west past the 书院 onto the stone highway. Streets are as wide as their class (tools/maps/standard.json); every building with rooms of its own is its outside here, entered by its door.

ground: the woods south of the town (卧龙岗)
roads: 山坳: the track north to 野羊山
and the winding track east to 青石村
黄土小径, winding east up the hill
the ruts the carts have worn into the highway
props: the old memorial arch (牌坊) at the town's north end
weathered rocks on the col: the town ends, the bare mountain begins
the government notice about the 野羊山 bandits
雪亭驿's bounty board on the street (native, A2 经验节奏)
the stone lions either side of the gate
the mountain wall east of the road
the slope west of the road

inn.note: 饮风客栈's ground floor: the door east onto the square (the ebony sign beside it), the counter with the waiter on the north side and the jars behind it, tables where travellers trade news, the stairs up in the north-east corner, and the glowing red-wood door in the north-west (the wizards' way, not open). The way from the middle of the room to the door stays clear.

props: the door east onto the square
wine jars and shelves behind the counter

inn_upstairs.note: The inn upstairs: inn_2f (the corridor), n_room, e_room and w_room.

fills: shared linen cabinet between the north beds
west writing desk and tucked stool

cellar.note: The cellar under the weapon storage (secret_storage).

bank.note: 安记钱庄: swept clean inside and out; the stout clerk sits behind the counter with its sign; the door east onto the street.

props: the counter, its sign on it

smithy.note: 打铁铺子: the forge lights the walls red; hoes, hammers and spades piled in the corner.

herbshop.note: 桑邻药铺: a large shop smelling of sandalwood, the counter along the north side, the great unlabelled cabinet behind it.

props: the great medicine cabinet, its drawers unlabelled
the counter along the north side

postoffice.note: 雪亭驿: the post with few comers now; its wooden board above the door.

workplace.note: 谷物加工厂: where the grain is husked into rice, many busy at work; the door west onto the street.

hockshop.note: 丰登当铺: a middling pawnshop, its light dim, the old counter with its board; the carved door west onto the street, a blue curtain (非请莫入) east into the store room of locked chests.

nodes.name: HockshopCounter
nodes.text: 柜台 · 估价 / 卖断

school.note: 淳风武馆 inside its wall: the red gate west into the wide sand yard where the trainees drill, the weapon hall north of it, the main hall east with its five chairs, then the 天井 of rare flowers round its stone pillar, the study north, the guest room south, the inner court east.

props: weapon racks along the yard's south wall
five 太师椅 facing the door
the stone pillar with writing on it

nodes.name: ShrineDoor
nodes.note: 内院's ways east to the shrine and north and south to the family's and servants' rooms (not open)

temple.note: 城隍庙: very old, the red-faced 城隍 on the altar, the shrine blackened by incense; doors west onto the square and south onto the path.

props: the altar and the red-faced 城隍

academy.note: 书院: old but kept clean, a landscape on the wall; its door north onto the street, a wooden door west into the side room (not open).
